patterns.note: Sections often feature an asymmetrical two-column layout, balancing large text blocks on one side with illustrative elements or content cards on the other, creating visual interest and clear hierarchy.
Key words within large, bold, uppercase headings are frequently highlighted with a vibrant lime-green accent color, drawing attention and reinforcing brand identity.

The site uses a high-contrast palette of black and off-white for primary content, punctuated by a vibrant, multi-color gradient in the hero and a strong lime-green accent for CTAs and text highlights.
Content sections and individual elements within them reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling, creating a dynamic and engaging user experience.

Content cards and interactive elements consistently feature soft, rounded corners and often incorporate gradient backgrounds or vibrant imagery, distinguishing them from the more minimal page background.

technique_notes: Implement smooth scrolling and scroll-triggered element reveals using a library like locomotive-scroll. Elements should animate into view (e.g., fade up, slide in from bottom) as their parent section becomes visible in the viewport, often with a slight delay or stagger for multiple elements. The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the screen with a subtle shadow.

Create a full-bleed hero section with a dynamic, multi-color gradient background that spans the entire viewport width. Overlay large, bold, uppercase typography, with specific words highlighted using a bright accent color. Integrate playful, custom illustrations and a device mock-up to showcase the product.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy, uppercase display headings (up to ~4-5x body text size) with key words highlighted in an accent color, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; most interactive elements and content cards feature soft, rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of calm and openness, while content within cards is more balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of a vibrant, playful gradient hero with a friendly illustrated character, combined with bold, almost brutalist-style uppercase typography and hand-drawn accent squiggles, creates a unique and approachable brand identity that feels both modern and whimsical.
